protocol.description: Permissionless EVM shared-security primitive providing modular restaking infrastructure. Core components: Vaults (hold restaked collateral), Operators (infrastructure providers), Networks (consumer protocols setting their own slashing), Resolvers (slashing veto arbiters), Delegators (collateral allocation managers). Core contracts are non-upgradeable on Ethereum. EigenLayer direct competitor; distinguishes by permissionlessness, any-ERC-20 collateral, and immutable core design.
